phase4a.rule: chosen spell option with is_instant_speed (catalog); early = step upkeep or draw and actor == active player; unknown card types counted apart and left out

P0-2_threat_ladder.rule: target decisions, and those with >= 2 options

P0-3_trigger_order.rule: trigger_order decisions, and those with >= 2 options

P1-1_combo_recognition.rule: NOT_COUNTABLE directly (needs a package match); proxy: priority decisions with an opponent permanent on the board

P1-2_timing_remainder.rule: postcombat candidates: non-instant spells chosen in the own precombat main; wipes: offered spells whose oracle text has 'destroy all' or 'exile all'

P1-3_interaction_discipline.rule: opponent turns on which the actor passes although an instant-speed spell was offered (the P2 remainder shares these windows)

P1-4_P10_x_breakpoints.rule: announce_x and multi_amount decisions; announce_x with X > 0

P4_fast_path.rule: mana_payment decisions (volume a fixed rule would not evaluate)

P5_profiling.rule: NOT_COUNTABLE from a dump (no wall time per decision); size as proxy

P7_transcript_schema.rule: bytes per decision of the dump as the transcript volume

P8_combat_remainder.rule: declare_attacker and declare_blocker decisions (an upper bound)

P9_replication_remainder.rule: NOT_COUNTABLE from one dump (needs duplicate keys across runs)

P3_costed_may_remainder.rule: choose_use decisions whose prompt has pay, life or sacrifice

P0-1_remainder.rule: NOT_COUNTABLE directly (the unset inputs are missing by definition)

mana_hold.rule: NOT_COUNTABLE (hand contents are not in the dump, only hand_count)
